item.title: Chatbot Memory on GitHub: Open-Source Repos (2026)
item.description:
Chatbot memory on GitHub falls into three groups: chat apps you self-host that already remember users (Open WebUI, LibreChat, LobeHub, SillyTavern), memory libraries you add to your own bot (Mem0, Letta, Graphiti, Memobase, Hindsight and others), and templates that show the pattern in a few files. Licenses range from MIT to AGPL to custom terms, so check before you ship.

Every repo below was opened and checked through the GitHub API on 8 October 2026. Stars are rounded and measure attention, not quality. For a deeper comparison of memory engines only, see open-source AI memory systems compared.

item.title: Open Source AI Memory Systems Compared: GitHub Repos
item.description:
The leading open-source AI agent memory systems on GitHub are Mem0, MemPalace, Hindsight, Graphiti, Cognee, Letta, LangMem, MemOS, Memori, Honcho, Basic Memory and Memobase. Most are Apache-2.0 or MIT, written in Python, and self-hostable with Docker. They differ in storage (vectors, graphs, files), in how much is truly open versus paid, and in what they’re built for.

If you want the most complete fully open option, it’s Hindsight: its MIT server includes graph and temporal recall, consolidation and reflect, which Mem0 keeps on its paid Platform, and it leads Mem0 on the long-history BEAM benchmark by 9.8 points at 1M tokens and 15.5 at 10M (vendor-run). This page covers only open-source projects: repos, licenses, stars, languages and strengths. Star counts and licenses come from the GitHub API on 12 October 2026. For hosted options and benchmarks, see the LLM memory comparison. For background, see AI agent memory explained.
